description: This file defines an API health check class for the eShopWeb application, which verifies the health of the catalog-items API endpoint by sending an HTTP GET request and checking for a specific string in the response content.

classes.name: ApiHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check for the catalog-items API endpoint by querying the URL and inspecting the response content to determine health status.

methods.name: ApiHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check with configuration for the base URL.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check by sending an HTTP request to the catalog-items endpoint and analyzing the response content to assess health.
